messages:
Priya (People Ops): quick one — Ellen's bday is next Thursday. team vote: desk plant (:seedling:) or pancake breakfast in the kitchen (:pancakes:)? please vote + say if you’ll be in-office or remote
Jake: :pancakes: in-person for sure. I can bring a griddle if needed
Tanya: :seedling: would be cute for her desk, low maintenance plant and I can wrap it
Elena: Pancakes sound fun tho. if remote, can we do a $15 e-gift card + card?
Sam: planting the plant vote. I’ll be remote but can ship a small succ to Ellen — need shipping addr
Zoe: Pancakes! also love the card idea. I can print a silly meme collage to put with it :laughing:
Priya (People Ops): ok putting quick tally here — Pancakes: Jake, Elena, Zoe (3). Plant: Tanya, Sam (2). undecided: Priya (me) leaning pancakes. more votes pls by EOD
Jake: if pancakes win I can volunteer 8:30–9:30 to cook. got a small electric griddle
Tanya: if plant wins i’ll source a nice pot and get a handwritten tag. budget ok? $25 cap?
Priya (People Ops): budget is $30. if pancake team needs more we can top up. also can someone volunteer to get paper plates/utensils?
Sam: I can pick up napkins/plates on my way in.
Elena: I’ll draft the e-card for remote folks and add the meme collage Zoe mentioned
Zoe: sending a mock in a sec :party_parrot:
calendar-bot: Reminder set — Ellen Birthday (All-day) — 2026-05-07. Invite sent to #people-ops
Priya (People Ops): final vote check: Pancakes 4, Plant 2. pancakes win. remote care package (egift) for those not on-site. thanks everyone — will post sign-up for who brings what in ~30m
Jake: yay pancakes :pancakes: :thumbsup:
Tanya: sweet! happy to contribute a plant for her desk too as a backup if Ellen wants to keep it
Priya (People Ops): noted — backup plant option. thanks all. tagging @Ellen? we’ll keep it low-key :)
Elena: bringing coffee :coffee:
Sam: shipping address DMed Priya
Priya (People Ops): perfect — closing poll. I’ll create a quick checklist and send the final note to #general so others can chip in if they want.
